assets.modifications: Sixteen generated clips. Startup, 22.05 kHz: boom (0.5 s), small boom (0.3 s), clank (40 ms), thud (80 ms), hum loop (1.0 s), klaxon (three 120 ms square chirps, 0.5 s), servo loop (1.2 kHz sine with a 6 Hz vibrato, 1.0 s), winch loop (90 Hz saw with a 7 Hz wobble, 1.0 s), whine (sine sweep 300 Hz to 1.8 kHz, 0.6 s) and, added 2026-10-13 in an AI-assisted pass (Claude Code) and not yet picked by ear, chirp (two soft sine blips a fifth apart, 1.32 kHz then 1.98 kHz, 0.15 s) and actuator (a low-passed saw gliding 150 to 230 Hz and back with a 38 Hz gear ripple, 0.24 s), and fuse_tick (a 1 ms strike on 2.35 and 3.9 kHz partials over a 520 Hz body, 70 ms; added later on 2026-10-13 in the same kind of pass, not yet picked by ear); all three are pure tones that draw nothing from the seeded noise, so the earlier clips keep their bytes. Detailed, 44.1 kHz (added 2026-10-10): relay_spark (recipe A: snap, 120 Hz pulsing buzz and crackle, 0.34 s), records_arc (recipe B: N-wave crack, short housing knock, restrike, pulsing tail with the late crackle faded out, 0.65 s), bolt_arc (recipe B: 0.5 s build of buzz and crackle, then the crack and restrike, 0.8 s) and growl_warning (recipe C: chaotic subharmonic throat in a metal chassis with a wandering swell and two snarl bursts, 1.2 s). Retired 2026-10-10: the generated hiss loop, arc crackle and growl (replaced by the recordings and the detailed recipes). Played through AudioStreamPlayer nodes on the Effects bus; volume and pitch are set per use.
